# TimeReversalInvariantTopologicalAlloy

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A photonic material engineered with disorder (alloying) that preserves time-reversal symmetry while exhibiting topologically protected edge states. Enables robust light routing in interconnects without requiring magnetic fields or breaking time-reversal symmetry, critical for scalable photonic TCC fabrics.
